text:
Items before the meal: a plate with a spring roll or fried roll (2 pieces), a tortilla wrap cut in two (turkey/avo/cheese), a tomato-cucumber-feta salad, a fruit bowl, chicken-corn soup, orange juice, a lemon drink, and water.

Estimated energy and mass of each item, with what was left:
- Wrap: about 300 kcal and 200 g. One half is left, so about half was eaten, roughly 150 kcal and 100 g.
- Rolls (the fried or rice-paper ones): about 2 pieces at 250 kcal total and 150 g. One piece is partly left, so roughly 60% was eaten, about 150 kcal and 90 g.
- Salad: about 80 kcal and 120 g, all eaten.
- Fruit: about 90 kcal and 200 g, all eaten.
- Soup: about 100 kcal and 250 g, all eaten with a little residue, so about 90 kcal and 230 g.
- Orange juice: about 100 kcal and 200 g, all drunk.
- Lemon drink: about 80 kcal and 200 g, all drunk.
- Water: 0 kcal. It is still partly left, so I counted none of it.

Totals:
- Energy: 150 + 150 + 80 + 90 + 90 + 100 + 80 = 740 kcal.
- Mass: 100 + 90 + 120 + 200 + 230 + 200 + 200 = 1140 g. I included the drinks in this figure.
